decisions: Use a confident civic-workspace palette: navy for structure, teal for primary action, amber for priority and coral only for alerts.
Use a persistent sidebar from tablet upward and an accessible collapsible navigation panel on mobile.
Use compact metric cards, clear status pills, and responsive card alternatives for data tables.
Keep operational verification distinct from LKPM OSS reporting; show its current state as a compact status pill while retaining the follow-up history as the audit trail.
Show assignment candidates as a dated priority snapshot, using teal for active Hijau targets and amber for standby Cadangan so projected value is never confused with official realization.
When no forecastable target exists, expose Amber only as an explicitly labeled verification workload; its gap may order contact work but must never be styled or counted as target projection.
For Kabag, combine current priorities and snapshot history as tabs on one page, and place the snapshot creation action on the dashboard.
Show all snapshot companies in one paginated priority queue; distinguish assigned, pending verification, and non-assignable rows while capping the initial PIC distribution at 100 total companies.
For Kepala Bagian, keep assigned PIC work and the Candidates priority table as separate sections on the same Assignment PIC page, with the distribution action directly above the Candidates table.

On the Kadis dashboard, present LKPM Disetujui for all four quarters as compact cards; quarters without any imported report data use a dark inactive state distinct from an available quarter with zero approvals.
Keep Kadis's schedule card focused on timing; combine the editable annual target, remaining amount, and rose progress bar in one annual achievement card, with the edit action on a pencil disclosure.

On Kadis's dashboard, place annual and active-quarter achievement cards side by side on wide screens; list any recorded prior-quarter shortfalls as informational, never automatically adding them to an already-set active target.
